text:
Leah (Design): Dropping a compact mock for the routing policies editor. Goals: clearer priority ordering, better validation visibility in the preview, and tighter CTAs. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/routing-editor (frame: Compact-UX).

ui-bot: Screenshot uploaded: routing_compact_v1.png

Theo (PM): Quick read: priority numbers on the chip are helpful. Can we make the chip target 44px tall for touch?

Leah (Design): Yes — 44px min, 16px semibold label. Adding a 24px drag handle with keyboard affordance.

Ravi (Frontend): Will implement focusable handle (Space to pick up, arrows to move). We should announce moves via aria-live: "Rule 4 moved to position 1".

Samira (Research): In tests, participants missed validation hints tucked in the preview. Recommend a top-level red badge with count and an inline first-error teaser.

Leah (Design): Proposed teaser copy: "Rule 3: No matchers defined. Add a condition (model/path/header)." Short and actionable.

Theo (PM): I like that. Also prefer excluding invalid rules from simulation by default and show "2 rules excluded" with a toggle to include. Less surprising.

Ravi (Frontend): Agree — simulator payload will mark excluded rules. Small note: don't shift layout when the teaser opens; use an anchored overlay.

Samira (Research): Language note: users preferred "Test rules" over "Preview simulation". Suggest A/B test header label.

Leah (Design): I'll add both variants in the mock, darken the priority orange to meet contrast, and include numeric priority + diagonal pattern for non-color cues. Action items: Leah update Figma, Ravi prototype keyboard reorder + aria announcements, Samira run 6-user quick A/B. Sync next Tue.

Theo (PM): One microcopy tweak: change primary button from "Add rule" to "Create rule" across header and card footers.

Leah (Design): Done in figma v1.1 — will ping when assets land. :white_check_mark:
